name: Kalashtar
printedArtCredit: Beet, Kalashtar portrait p. 18, verified in the Wizards gallery.
sourceDistinctions: In the original 2004 printing, Mindlink resolves at half Hit Dice, minimum 1, using the Expanded Psionics Handbook rules.
The setting book’s fallback is 30 ft. initial range and 1 round per character level. The psionics power uses close range and 10 minutes per manifester level.
The FAQ distinguishes the level of the racial ability from general manifester levels. The racial power-point reserve also exists without a psionic class.
portraitForm: Seravakri, an original Kalashtar Telepath Psion
